# **Defect 03 \- Add Self As An Emergency Contacts**

**Module**: Employee Detail \-\> Emergency Contact  
**Severity**: Major   
**Priority**: Medium  
**Status**: Open  
**Environment**: Chrome, Windows 11

### **Description**

Verify that the system prevents adding oneself as an emergency contact, as this violates business logic rules.

### **Steps-to-Reproduce**

1. Login to [https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login](https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login)   
2. Navigate to Employee Detail \-\> Emergency Contacts  
3. Click ‘Add’   
4. Enter the logged in user’s own name in the Name fields.  
5. Set relation to “Self”  
6. Fill in required contact fields  
7. Click ‘Save’

### **Expected Result** 

The system rejects the entry with a validation error. Employees are prohibited from adding themselves as an emergency contact.

### **Actual Result**

System not rejected the entry and no validation error. Employees successfully added to emergency contact.
